title: The test ratchet must refuse a stale baseline (or derive it)
description: The ratchet let .test-baseline.json go stale: test-skills#14 added 18 cases and #15 raised the cap to 79, and neither advanced the baseline (still 60 while the suite is 79), so every later PR inherits phantom +19 growth and fails max_new_tests_per_pr. Fix by making the gate REFUSE a merge whose baseline is below the collected count on the base, or by deriving the baseline instead of hand-keeping it. HELD, no build, per the leader.
